name: svg-signature-write
title: Signature
description: Five measured handwriting strokes are scheduled at distinct pen speeds with short lifts between them. A live nib follows the active path by arc length, making the signature feel written rather than revealed by one uniform CSS duration.

<script>
(function(){const R=window.INTRX={resolveAssets:value=>value};
R.createRuntime=function (stage) {
    let disposed = false, suspended = false, inViewport = true, sequence = 0, speed = 1;
    let realTime = performance.now(), virtualTime = realTime;
    const frames = new Map(), timers = new Map(), cleanups = new Set(), animations = new Set();
    const paused = () => suspended || document.hidden || !inViewport;
    function clock() {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (!paused()) virtualTime += (now - realTime) * speed;
      realTime = now;
      return virtualTime;
